noAccessDescription: Only a treasurer or an administrator can book expenses.
lockedDescription: The voucher has been exported to Fortnox and can no longer be changed.
notBookableDescription: Only approved expenses can be booked.
createDescription: Create the voucher. Enter the lines and get debit and credit to add up.
editDescription: Adjust the voucher lines before the expense is exported to Fortnox.
saveFailed: The voucher could not be saved
linesHint: Debit and credit have to be equal.
lockedRowHint: The payment row is locked and cannot be removed
noReceiptDescription: This expense has no documentation attached.
dragRow: Drag to move the row (or Alt + arrow key)
unknownPaymentAccount: The payment account {account} is not in the chart of accounts. Fix it under Settings → Fortnox before booking.
unknownAccounts: These accounts are not in the chart of accounts: {list}. Add them, or pick others, before booking.
unknownCostCenters: These cost centres do not exist: {list}. Pick others before booking.
